Major AI Developments.title: Shirtless protest at AI Summit: Delhi Police nabs Youth Congress worker in Gwalior, total arrests 5
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police arrested Jitendra Yadav, a Youth Congress worker, in Gwalior in connection with a protest at the AI Impact Summit, bringing the total arrests to five. The protest involved Indian Youth Congress members displaying slogans and removing their shirts inside the venue. The arrests were made in response to the disruption caused by the protesters.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Indore develops AI-driven system to improve road safety, ease traffic
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Indore has developed an AI-powered C-V2X technology for smarter traffic management, utilizing 4G/5G networks to send real-time alerts to drivers. The system provides updates on road conditions, accidents, and congestion to enhance road safety. This technology aims to prevent accidents and improve traffic flow by dynamically allocating communication resources.
